decision: JFC 2026-10-05: shell freeze lifted; approved capabilities must not regress without an explicit product decision.
coverage: Initial protected inventory. Passing these tests is not proof of complete UI/UX coverage or physical-device health.

capabilities.contract: Earned/Paid/Still due, partial payments, statements, history, person and shelf editors and historical deep links remain reachable.
Both product/SKU and rack/event views remain available.
Selected period survives dashboard-to-app payment navigation.
Counter is a sales channel, never implicit removal of the piece/shelf commission.
New payments are exact, auditable facts; partial payments, retries and legacy history remain coherent.
Split and return adjustments preserve paid history.
Archived or deleted shelves do not reappear from stale peers.
Rendering preserves photos; recovery uses exact shelf evidence and respects newer images.
Exports are importable and preserve photo evidence; corrupt imports do not erase business state.
Business edits converge without mixing tenants or applying operations twice.
Stale legacy zero cannot erase valid positive stock; legitimate modern zero remains supported.
Undo and returns preserve the existing accounting and stock semantics.
Changing display language does not overwrite the user's business name.
The PIN badge describes the controlling worker, not whichever cache is newest.
